requirement:
HC represents a FIXME acknowledgment as a graph node and exposes its tracking
issue relationships as labeled edges to GitHub issue nodes. A named FIXME also
connects the acknowledgment to the requirement whose gap it acknowledges;
an unnamed FIXME connects directly to its tracking issues.
Each issue named by the acknowledgment is available through its tracking edges.
rationale:
`requirements.sdk.habeas.fixme_graph` has no {test} references or :test: anchors. I checked its Tests edges (none) and searched for other references to it (none in tests). Its obligations are untested:
- A FIXME acknowledgment is a graph node.
- Its tracking issues are exposed as labeled edges to GitHub issue nodes.
- A named FIXME also connects to the requirement whose gap it acknowledges.
- An unnamed FIXME connects directly to its tracking issues.
- Each issue named by the acknowledgment is available through its tracking edges, including when one acknowledgment names several issues.

This gap is acknowledged. `src/sdk.rs#enum[HabeasNode]` carries a `{fixme} requirements.sdk.habeas.fixme_graph` reference naming nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem#26, which is open. Its body says named and unnamed acknowledgments, source ownership, and multiple issue targets have no tests. That describes the missing-test gap for this requirement. No other test gap is outside the acknowledgment.
